convention: The hull box reaches the hull and turret roof; sights, antennas and roof guns are dressing within 0.3 m (bulky) or 0.15 m across (thin); the pivot sits at the centre of the turret ring (a fixed howitzer mount: its trunnion); the muzzle sits at the real barrel length. Box length covers the body (hull plus any armoured turret overhang), centred on the box origin.

thresholds.note: Slice 07's guesses, kept: every fix row below clears them by a wide margin or is named as borderline. muzzle_reach_m is added by lane F-C (the slice set none for muzzles).

notes.note: turret shape looks too big, or body too small
notes.why: Per card in question 3: the M109 and 2S19 frames are too tall for their roofs, and the PzH frame too short for its turret overhang. Every card's gun mount is misplaced. The proportions themselves are art.
The skirts (sp_howitzers.py:101-105) run to half - 0.30 m at the front, past where the glacis starts; slice 09 side_skirt, adopted in slice 29.

3_turret_or_body.us_m109_paladin_m109a7: Neither too big nor too small in plan. The real turret is longer (4.8 m against 3.7 m, overhanging the hull rear by 0.8 m), and the hull shorter (6.19 m against 6.8 m). The real turret stands 1.14 m over a 1.64 m deck; the model's 1.30 m over 1.55 m makes it look tall on a low body. Frame: height 3.25 to 2.80 m and the gun mount. Art: raise the deck 0.09 m, lower the turret roof 0.07 m, lengthen the turret into a rear bustle, shorten the hull at the nose.
3_turret_or_body.europe_pzh_2000_tracked_155_mm_howitzer: Body too small. The deck is about 1.8 m (model 1.62 m), the turret roof 3.06 m (model 2.82 m), and the turret 4.8 m long (model 4.25 m), overhanging the rear by 0.4 m. Frame: length 7.87 to 8.33 m and the gun mount; height already right. Art: raise the deck and the turret, lengthen the turret rearward.
3_turret_or_body.eastern_2s19_msta_s_2s19m2: Close; the turret is a little low and short. Deck 1.29 m (model 1.40 m); turret roof 2.82 m (model 2.70 m); turret 3.99 m from x +1.53 to -2.46 (model 3.8 m, +1.20 to -2.60). Frame: height 2.99 to 2.82 m, width 3.58 to 3.38 m, the gun mount. Art: drop the deck 0.1 m, raise the turret 0.12 m, bring its front forward 0.3 m; the barrel is drawn 1.7 m long (the 7.15 m tube placed wholly ahead of the trunnion).
3_turret_or_body.eastern_plz_05_chinese_tracked_155_mm_ho: Unresolved: no square-on reference. The frame keeps its box; only the gun mount moves. The family slice judges the turret against the quarter photos.
